title: Common
description: Shared enumerations and value objects. Every other contract references this file, so a change here is a breaking change everywhere.

InputMode.title: InputMode
InputMode.description: How a learner produces an answer. Every mode normalises to LearnerResponse.canonical_text (ADR-0002).

OutputChannel.title: OutputChannel
OutputChannel.description: How content is presented to a learner. The Modality Router composes one primary channel with any number of simultaneous support channels (ADR-0001).

TextComplexity.title: TextComplexity
TextComplexity.description: 'easy_read' enforces the rules in docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md: 15 words per sentence, one idea per screen, supporting image per idea.

SpeechStatus.title: SpeechStatus
SpeechStatus.description: Drives ASR personalisation (M8) and the PPI dimension weighting (M7). Self-declared during onboarding, never inferred.

Difficulty.title: Difficulty
Difficulty.description: CEFR-mapped difficulty tier. 1 = A1 survival phrases, 5 = C1 nuanced negotiation.

AssetRef.title: AssetRef
AssetRef.description: A pointer to a media object in storage. Never an inline blob.

Pictograph.title: Pictograph
Pictograph.description: A symbol from a CC-licensed AAC set. Mappings are human-verified; automatic mapping produces embarrassing results.

IslClip.title: IslClip
IslClip.description: A human-signed Indian Sign Language video clip. We use recorded clips, not a generated avatar - a bad avatar is worse than none.

gloss.description: ISL gloss notation. ISL grammar is not English word order; the gloss records the actual signed sequence.
